sources.note: University identity and Business Management degree/program distinction; operations research appears only as curriculum topic.
Business/Financial Services faculty and program coordinators examined.
Two-college structure examined; professional college explicitly describes sixteen programs and one Mathematics department, no separate engineering/operations unit.

decisions.reason: Official Business Administration page calls Management a major; faculty page names a program coordinator, and college structure distinguishes professional programs from its Mathematics department. Do not promote degree/program to department.

limitations: Business curriculum includes operations research, but the reviewed official pages establish Business Management as a program/major, not a separately named operations department or research unit. No in-scope unit verified; this does not assert absence of all operations teaching.
